sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 白家月：安妮，我们在这儿呢。
blocks.en: Bai: Annie, we are over here.

blocks.zh: 安妮：天中、家月，你们猜我是怎么过来的？
blocks.en: Annie: Tianzhong, Jiayue, guess how I got here.

blocks.zh: 白家月：坐公交车吗？
blocks.en: Bai: By bus?

blocks.zh: 安妮：我先坐的公交车，然后骑共享单车，快到那边那个出口时又推了一小段。
blocks.en: Annie: I took the bus first, then rode a shared bike. Near that exit, I pushed it for a short distance.

blocks.zh: 白家月：我看很多人都骑共享单车，我还没骑过呢。
blocks.en: Bai: I see many people riding shared bikes, but I have not tried one.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：我骑过，很方便的。第一次骑的时候，你打开微信，对着共享单车上的二维码扫一下，在App上完成注册就可以了，怎么使用、费用标准什么的App上都有说明。
blocks.en: Chen: I have; they are convenient. The first time, open WeChat, scan the bike's QR code and register in the app. The app explains how to use it, the charges and so on.

blocks.zh: 白家月：好啊！哪天我出去办事时也试试。
blocks.en: Bai: Great! I will try it one day when I go out on errands.

blocks.zh: 白家月骑过共享单车吗？如果没骑过，她想什么时候骑？
blocks.en: Has Bai ridden a shared bike? If not, when would she like to?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 她没骑过，想哪天出去办事时试试。
answers.en: She has not, and wants to try one when she goes out on errands.

blocks.zh: 第一次骑共享单车时应该做些什么？了解些什么？
blocks.en: What should you do and learn before your first shared-bike ride?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 应该打开微信扫码，在App上注册，并了解使用方法和费用标准。
answers.en: Open WeChat, scan the code, register in the app and learn how to use it and what it costs.

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 安妮到白家月和陈天中的学校玩，她先坐……，然后……，快到一个出口时又……。白家月说她看很多人……，但她……呢。陈天中介绍说，他骑过共享单车，……。第一次……，打开微信，对着……扫一下，在App上……就可以了，而且，怎么使用、……什么的App上……。白家月听完表示，她哪天出去……。
prompt.en: Annie visited her friends’ university. She first took …, then …, and near an exit she…. Bai had seen many people … but had not…. Chen said shared bikes were…. The first time, open WeChat, scan … and … in the app, which also explains use and…. Bai said she would … when going out….

answer.zh: 安妮到白家月和陈天中的学校玩，她先坐公交车，然后骑共享单车，快到出口时又推了一小段。白家月还没骑过共享单车。陈天中说共享单车很方便，第一次骑时，打开微信扫码，在App上完成注册就可以了。App上有使用方法和费用标准的说明。白家月想哪天出去办事时试试。
answer.en: Annie took a bus and then a shared bike to visit her friends, pushing it briefly near the exit. Bai had never tried one. Chen explained that shared bikes are convenient: scan the code with WeChat and register in the app, which explains use and fees. Bai wanted to try one when running errands.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 安妮：差点儿忘了，我给你们看个短视频。
blocks.en: Annie: I nearly forgot. Let me show you a short video.

blocks.zh: 白家月：啊？你们拍的？真不错！
blocks.en: Bai: Oh, did you make it? It is really good!

blocks.zh: 安妮：对！前段时间老师留了个作业，叫各个小组拍个短视频，介绍中国美食。我们小组讨论后决定，由AI小语演厨师，做出中国各地的著名小吃。拍完后，老师说很不错。
blocks.en: Annie: Yes! Our teacher assigned each group a short video introducing Chinese food. We decided that AI Xiaoyu would play a chef making famous snacks from around China. The teacher liked the finished video.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：嗯，语言也很幽默！
blocks.en: Chen: The language is humorous too!

blocks.zh: 安妮：后来这个视频让我同学放到了互联网上，很多人都来点赞。
blocks.en: Annie: A classmate later posted it online, and many people liked it.

blocks.zh: 白家月：看来大家都喜欢这个视频。
blocks.en: Bai: It seems everyone likes the video.

blocks.zh: 安妮：后边我们打算拍第二个、第三个，让小语带大家到中国各地走一走、看一看。
blocks.en: Annie: We plan to make a second and third video, with Xiaoyu showing people different parts of China.

blocks.zh: 陈天中：这样大家就能通过你们的视频了解中国了，我支持你们！
blocks.en: Chen: Then people can learn about China through your videos. You have my support!

blocks.zh: 老师留作业后，安妮和同学们拍了什么样的短视频？
blocks.en: What video did Annie and her classmates make?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 他们让AI小语演厨师，介绍中国各地的著名小吃。
answers.en: They had AI Xiaoyu play a chef introducing famous snacks from around China.

blocks.zh: 安妮后边还想拍什么短视频？
blocks.en: What videos does Annie want to make next?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 她想让小语带大家到中国各地走一走、看一看。
answers.en: She wants Xiaoyu to show people different parts of China.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 安妮骑共享单车到了白家月、陈天中的学校，三人从共享单车聊到AI眼镜和3D打印机，从绿色经济聊到上门经济。科技到底对世界产生了怎样的影响？他们都认为，科技确实改变了人们的生活。
blocks.en: Annie rode a shared bike to her friends’ university. The three discussed shared bikes, AI glasses, 3D printers, the green economy and home services. What impact has technology had on the world? They all agreed it has changed people's lives.

blocks.zh: 接着，安妮给大家看了她和同学们拍的短视频。安妮说，短视频是用手机拍的，他们装了一些免费的App，仅用几天就拍完了。视频里，小语做的小吃丰富多样，看起来好吃极了。短视频推出后，大家认为非常精彩，白家月和陈天中看后也特别喜欢，并且表示支持他们拍更多的视频。
blocks.en: Annie then showed the video she and her classmates made. They installed free apps on their phones and completed filming in just a few days. Xiaoyu's varied snacks looked delicious. Viewers found the released video excellent. Bai and Chen also loved it and supported making more.

blocks.zh: 安妮和同学们的短视频是怎么拍的？
blocks.en: How did Annie and her classmates make their video?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 他们用手机，装了一些免费的App，仅用几天就拍完了。
answers.en: They used phones with free apps and finished in just a few days.

blocks.zh: 对于安妮他们拍的短视频，白家月和陈天中有什么想法？
blocks.en: What did Bai and Chen think of the video?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 他们特别喜欢，并支持安妮他们拍更多的视频。
answers.en: They loved it and supported making more videos.

prompt.en: Annie rode … to the university. They discussed …, AI glasses, 3D printers, … and home services, agreeing that…. She showed them…. It was filmed with … using … and finished in…. In the video, … made snacks that were … and looked…. After release, viewers thought …; her friends also … and supported….

answer.zh: 安妮骑共享单车到朋友们的学校，大家从共享单车聊到AI眼镜和3D打印机，从绿色经济聊到上门经济。他们认为科技改变了人们的生活。接着安妮给大家看了她和同学们拍的短视频。他们用手机和免费的App，仅用几天就拍完了。视频里，小语做的小吃丰富多样，看起来很好吃。大家都觉得视频很精彩，白家月和陈天中也支持他们拍更多的视频。

sections.intro: “到底” is used in questions for persistent inquiry or emphasis: what exactly, who on earth, or whether something really is the case.

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 随着互联网技术的发展，现在又出现了一种新的服务方式——上门经济，就是预约者通过网上预约，让服务人员在合适的时间到家里或者约好的地点服务，服务内容有上门做饭、照顾小动物、取东西等。赵女士养了一只猫，由于工作等原因，她需要经常出差，然而又很担心猫的安全。有了上门服务后，她觉得方便多了，不必再找亲戚帮忙。每次出差，在网上预约并支付费用后，服务人员就会按她提出的要求上门照顾小猫，大大减轻了她的压力，赵女士也特别满意。
blocks.en: Internet technology has enabled the home-service economy. Customers book online for workers to visit their home or another agreed location at a suitable time. Services include cooking, pet care and collecting items. Ms Zhao has a cat and travels often for work, worrying about its safety. Home services mean she no longer needs relatives to help. Before each trip she books and pays online, and workers care for the cat according to her requests. This greatly reduces her stress, and she is satisfied.

blocks.zh: 当然，上门经济也有一些问题，特别是现有服务人员有些还不够专业，需要重新学习，提高服务质量。
blocks.en: Of course, home services also face problems. Some current workers are not sufficiently professional and need further learning to improve service quality.

blocks.zh: 什么是上门经济？
blocks.en: What is the home-service economy?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

answers.zh: 顾客在网上预约，让服务人员到家里或约好的地点提供服务。
answers.en: Customers book online for workers to provide services at their home or an agreed location.

blocks.zh: 上门经济还有什么问题？
blocks.en: What problems remain with home services?
blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

answers.zh: 有些服务人员还不够专业，需要学习并提高服务质量。
answers.en: Some workers need more professional skills and training to improve service quality.

blocks.zh: 安妮和同学们拍的短视频很有意思，很多人点赞。请以“我也想拍个短视频”为题目，写一篇短文，谈谈你想拍什么样的短视频，想怎么拍，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Write at least 140 Chinese characters titled “I Want to Make a Short Video, Too”, explaining what you want to film and how.
blocks.heading: Writing · at least 140 characters

answers.zh: 我也想拍个短视频，向朋友们介绍我的学校。我打算和两位同学一起完成这个任务。首先，我们要讨论内容，选好拍摄的时间和地点。然后，我用手机拍学校的教室、图书馆和操场，一位同学负责介绍，另一位同学帮我们检查声音。我们还想请老师说几句话，让大家了解学校的课程。拍完以后，我们会用免费的App把视频做好，加上简单的中文和英文说明。最后，我们把视频发给家人和朋友，请他们提出建议。我希望通过这个视频，让更多人喜欢我们的学校，也让自己的中文口语取得进步。
answers.en: I want to make a short video introducing my school with two classmates. We will discuss content, timing and locations. I will film classrooms, the library and sports field on my phone; one classmate will present and the other check sound. We will invite a teacher to introduce courses. Afterwards we will edit with a free app and add simple Chinese and English explanations. We will share it with family and friends for feedback. I hope more people will like our school and that my spoken Chinese will improve.
